user_intent: 如果 人在家 那么 增加 亮度
期望 温度 处于 18 ℃ 到 25 ℃
期望 声音 处于 59 dB 到 74 dB
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_light_up() philips_zhiyi_light
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() > 25 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_cool() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_temperature() < 18 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_mode_to_heat() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 74 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_low_volume() X_stereo
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 59 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_high_volume() X_stereo
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN beep() LG_fire_detector
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN open_door() Blade_Star_smart_door
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_light_off() philips_zhiyi_light
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() smart_inverter_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() mijia_air_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() X_stereo
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_diffuser
